This module needs SELinux policies

%1$s includes SELinux policies. Loading is disabled or not yet effective for this boot, so features that depend on these policies may not work. Allowing policy changes can expand module permissions, affect system stability and make environment changes detectable. To allow them, enable “Load module SELinux policies” in Settings and confirm it has taken effect. Confirming this notice only closes it; it does not enable policy loading.
